title: The Book of Revelation Bible Crossword Puzzle — Free on iOS
heading: The Book of Revelation Bible Crossword
description: Solve a Revelation Bible crossword: Patmos, the seven churches, the seals and trumpets, the Lamb and the new Jerusalem. Free KJV puzzles on iOS.
prose: An old man on a small island writes down what he is shown: seven letters to seven churches, a door opened in heaven, a book with seven seals that only the Lamb can open, and at the end a city coming down out of heaven with no temple in it and no need of the sun.
The Book of Revelation is the hardest puzzle in the archive, and the one people most often come back to. The closing verse is the LORD's own name for himself in the first chapter.

clues.text: Isle where John was, for the word of God
Churches in Asia, and seals, and trumpets
Only he was found worthy to open the book

verseText: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the ending, saith the Lord, which is, and which was, and which is to come, the Almighty.
